ItemID: NA; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country-rock direction fits my interest in Blown Away, but it is not my first pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing right now than blues and song-focused albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Super Session; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-rock playing fits my recent Hendrix and Clapton listening, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: CSNY 1974; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic-rock songwriting appeals, though I am not looking for a long live collection today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blue & Lonesome; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues focus suits my taste, but I would choose the Clapton-related album first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After You Should Be So Lucky, I would welcome more of that musical circle through Tom Petty's rock sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent Old Sock listening makes this relaxed, Clapton-led blues tribute an especially appealing choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Crosseyed Heart; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented rock sounds relevant, but the two albums I selected interest me more today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Traditional pop standards are not what I want from my current blues and roots-rock listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wrote a Song For Everyone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar roots-rock songs appeal, but a collaborative collection is a lower priority today.
